name: SD: Software delivery pipeline (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A team's delivery pipeline, counted every hour: changes developers are working on, commits waiting to build, builds running, tests running, artifacts waiting to deploy, and releases recently deployed and still being watched. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the pipeline (the ground truth is in sd-ci/truth.model.json, including a stage the dashboard does not count), so discovery can be checked exactly. Work follows office hours and sprints; the build farm changes are announced. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
